file.content:
budget-ish notes to self

not tracking everything against a number, just the two things that actually
worry me:

- eating out / coffee: want to keep this under $260 a month. it's been
  creeping up and i don't think i'm noticing it day to day.
- amazon/shopping in general: it's probably my biggest category overall but
  i've got more slack there, roughly $1200/month is fine, just want to keep
  an eye on it so it doesn't quietly become $2000.

everything else (groceries, gas, subscriptions, etc) i'm not budgeting
against a specific number right now, just want to see where it's going.

mkdir -p "C:/Users/<user>/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-<user>-AppData-Local-Temp-prompt-evals-session---2vnsmt/7904aea2-a8f0-4547-881a-745a1ea49c54/scratchpad" && cd "C:/Users/<user>/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-<user>-AppData-Local-Temp-prompt-evals-session---2vnsmt/7904aea2-a8f0-4547-881a-745a1ea49c54/scratchpad" && cat > a.py <<'EOF'
import re,collections
lines=open(r"C:/Users/<user>/AppData/Local/Temp/prompt-evals-session-__2vnsmt/personal_expenses.txt").read().splitlines()[3:]
cats={'Dining & Coffee':['Local Coffee','Chipotle',"McDonald",'Rustic Tap','Panera','Starbucks','Sushi Kame','Thai Orchid','Bagel Corner',"Luigi"],
'Shopping':['Amazon (','Amazon,','Amazon $',': Amazon','Best Buy','Target','REI','Old Navy','Barnes','IKEA','Home Depot'],
'Groceries':["Trader Joe",'Aldi','Kroger','Costco','Whole Foods'],
'Gas & Auto':['Shell','Chevron','BP Gas','Jiffy'],
'Rideshare & Parking':['Lyft','Uber','City Parking'],
'Bills & Subscriptions':['iCloud','Prime','Xfinity','Netflix','Planet Fitness App','Verizon','Spotify Premium'],
'Gym (Planet Fitness, non-app)':['Planet Fitness'],
'Health & Medical':['Physical Therapy','Walgreens','CVS','Dental'],
'Entertainment':['Steam','Spotify Concert','AMC','Bowl-O','Ticketmaster'],
'Travel (Aug trip)':['Delta','Airport Parking','Marriott','Hertz'],
'Transfers & Cash':['Zelle','Venmo','PayPal','ATM']}
mon={'6':'Jun','06':'Jun','7':'Jul','07':'Jul','8':'Aug','08':'Aug','Jun':'Jun','Jul':'Jul','Aug':'Aug'}
T=collections.defaultdict(float);items=collections.defaultdict(list)
for l in lines:
  if not l.strip():continue
  m=re.search(r'(Jun|Jul|Aug)|2026-(0[678])|\b(0?[678])[/-]\d',l)
  mo=mon[next(g for g in m.groups() if g)]
  amt=float(re.findall(r'-?\$?-?(\d+\.\d\d)',l)[-1]); 
  if 'Return' in l: amt=-amt
  if 'Amazon Prime' in l: c='Bills & Subscriptions'
  else:
    c=next((k for k,v in cats.items() if any(s in l for s in v)),None)
  if c is None: print("UNCAT",l)
  T[(mo,c)]+=amt; items[(mo,c)].append((l,amt))
for c in cats:
  r=[T[(m,c)] for m in ['Jun','Jul','Aug']]
  print(f"{c:32}"+"".join(f"{x:10.2f}" for x in r)+f"{sum(r):11.2f}")
print("TOTAL",[round(sum(v for (m,c),v in T.items() if m==mo),2) for mo in ['Jun','Jul','Aug']], round(sum(T.values()),2))
for k in [('Jun','Dining & Coffee'),('Jul','Dining & Coffee'),('Aug','Dining & Coffee'),('Jun','Shopping'),('Jul','Shopping'),('Aug','Shopping')]:
  print(k,len(items[k]),[a for _,a in items[k]])
EOF
